item.title: Lenovo Posts $57.18B H1 Revenue but Swings to $1.25B Net Loss
item.description:
Lenovo reported record fiscal H1 revenue of $57.18 billion, up 46% year over year, but swung to a GAAP net loss of $1.248 billion from prior-year profit, driven by a $3.596 billion fair-value loss on warrant-related derivative liabilities. Excluding that non-cash item, adjusted profit attributable to shareholders reached $2.436 billion, up 170%, with the Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) beating expectations on both revenue and margin.

原文标题：联想 2026 财年上半年营收 571.8 亿美元，归母亏损 12.48 亿美元

Why it matters：联想作为 AI 服务器与算力基础设施重要供应商，其财报揭示了 AI 硬件需求的真实景气度与盈利结构。

item.title: Voltage Glitching Unlocks 80GB HBM on Nvidia CMP 170HX Mining Card
item.description:
Hardware researcher Kate used voltage fault injection to rewrite protected fuse configurations, unlocking the Nvidia CMP 170HX mining card's 8GB of exposed HBM to a full 80GB and re-enabling disabled compute units. The modified card hit roughly 85.9 TFLOPS in a half-precision test, surpassing a reference A100 at about 72.5 TFLOPS, though the process requires per-card debugging and irreversible fuse changes.

原文标题：电压故障注入解锁矿卡 8GB 显存变 80GB

Why it matters：以极低成本硬件手段突破厂商算力裁剪，对关注二手算力与硬件安全的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: China Names 34 Lighthouse Smart Factories Including Xiaomi Auto
item.description:
China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and five other departments released the 2026 list of 34 Lighthouse Smart Factories, the top tier of the country's tiered smart-manufacturing cultivation system. Entries include Xiaomi Auto, Seres, FAW-Volkswagen, AVIC Xi'an Aircraft and Hudong-Zhonghua Shipbuilding, with the sector coverage expanding for the first time to pharmaceuticals and apparel. The second batch of lighthouse factories raised average labor productivity by 34.4% and production efficiency by 19.3%, while driving nearly 4,000 partner enterprises to upgrade digitally and intelligently.

原文标题：工信部公布 34 家领航级智能工厂 小米汽车等入选

Why it matters：国家级智能制造名单与量化效率数据，反映 AI 驱动制造落地的产业进展。

item.title: Alberta Proposes 600-Meter Buffer Between Data Centers and Homes
item.description:
Alberta, Canada has unveiled draft legislation requiring data centers of 10 MW or more to sit at least 600 meters from the nearest homes and barring them from prime farmland and irrigated land. The bill also mandates near-zero external cooling-water use, waste-heat recovery, and self-funded power infrastructure, with maximum fines raised to C$6 million.

原文标题：艾伯塔省拟要求数据中心距住宅至少 600 米

Why it matters：这是算力基础设施选址与资源约束的实质性监管信号，直接影响数据中心建设成本与布局。

item.title: Phanthy Unveils Phai-A1 and Phai-M1 Trained Entirely on Ascend Chips
item.description:
Phanthy (formerly 4Paradigm) has unveiled its first in-house foundation models: Phai-A1, a general language model, and Phai-M1, a video generation model for live-action film scenarios. Both were trained end-to-end on Huawei Ascend compute. Phai-A1 targets coding and agent workloads, claiming 8-10x faster responses than peers of similar size while running on a single RTX 3090 with native million-token context; Phai-M1 produces 15-second 720P clips with synchronized audio in about three minutes. Weights are slated for release on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

原文标题：范式发布 Phai-A1 与 Phai-M1 双模型 昇腾全链路训练

Why it matters：国产算力全链路训练基座模型并开放权重，是国产 AI 软硬协同的重要信号。

item.title: OpenAI Researchers Burn $2,400 a Day on AI Agents, Report Shows
item.description:
OpenAI published internal data showing exponential growth in researcher AI agent usage, with a typical researcher consuming roughly $2,400 a day at API prices and the top 10% exceeding $23,000. Agents now run the equivalent of 5.7 eight-hour human shifts per researcher daily, an 11-fold increase, yet experiments rose only 68% and capability gains stayed just above industry trend. Agents succeed 79% of the time at monitoring training runs but only 25% at writing inference and serving code, a weak spot that could cap overall research speedup.

原文标题：OpenAI 研究员日均消耗 2400 美元 AI 智能体算力

Why it matters：OpenAI 首次公开智能体算力消耗与产出效率的量化数据，为评估 AI 加速 AI 研究的真实边界提供稀缺一手证据。

item.title: Nvidia GPU Rental Prices Surge as Hopper Doubles and B300 Jumps 60%
item.description:
Nvidia disclosed on its earnings call that AI inference demand has driven rental prices up across GPU generations, with multi-year Hopper renewals reaching up to 2x the original price and B300 up over 60% since launch. CFO Colette Kress said token prices have fallen nearly 60% since May, spurring usage and compute demand, leaving capacity at hyperscalers and neoclouds fully utilized. Nvidia is also reported to require overseas data center partners to allocate at least 51% of services to non-Chinese customers, tightening advanced compute access for Chinese firms.

原文标题：英伟达 GPU 租赁价大涨 Hopper 翻倍 B300 涨超 60%

Why it matters：一线算力供需与定价信号直接来自英伟达财报会议，对判断 AI 基础设施成本与供给格局有实质参考价值。

item.title: Tencent Slashes Yuanbao Investment as AI Assistant Falls Short
item.description:
Tencent President Martin Lau admitted at the Q3 earnings call that consumer AI assistant Yuanbao fell short of expectations, prompting a sharp cut in investment and a pivot from user growth to model capability. Meanwhile, WeChat AI assistant Xiaowei has reached 30 million DAU, with quarterly costs after full rollout set to be lower than Yuanbao's earlier spending. The shift signals Tencent moving from costly standalone-app user acquisition to low-cost distribution inside the WeChat ecosystem.

item.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol Show Marked Personality Shifts
item.description:
Artificial Analysis evaluations show that GPT-6.2's Astra and Sol variants have shifted noticeably in behavior versus prior releases: responses are shorter, less structured but more answer-first, far less likely to admit uncertainty, and rated more natural-sounding. Evidence-based grounding also rises substantially at higher reasoning effort.

item.description:

He framed the split as Tesla focusing on real-world AI for self-driving and the Optimus robot, while SpaceX handles large-model AI work.

item.description:

item.title: FailTrace Reproduces Failed GitHub Actions Runs Locally from URL
item.description:
FailTrace is an open-source CLI that takes a failed GitHub Actions run URL, identifies the failing job and step, matches it to the workflow file at that exact commit, extracts the failure from logs, and tells developers how to reproduce it locally. It ships three subcommands (inspect, plan, repro), with repro running Linux jobs whose failing step is a run script inside Docker. The project is in early development and positions itself differently from act by explaining why a specific run failed and reproducing that failure.

原文标题：FailTrace 支持从 URL 本地复现 CI 失败

Why it matters：面向 CI 调试痛点的实用开源工具，从失败运行反向定位并本地复现，对日常使用 GitHub Actions 的开发者有直接价值。

item.title: China's Virtual Power Plants Hit 592 Projects with 20 GW Flexible Capacity
item.description:
China's National Energy Administration reported 592 operational virtual power plant (VPP) projects as of end-June 2026, up 78.9% year on year, with aggregate flexible capacity reaching 20.43 GW and beating the 2027 target two years early. Aggregated resources now span adjustable loads, distributed generation, storage and EV charging, with East, South and North China accounting for 81% of projects.

item.title: JEDEC Previews DDR6 Spec with 50% Wider Data Bus
item.description:
JEDEC has published a preview of the DDR6 DRAM specification, widening the data bus from 64bit to 96bit to match LPDDR6. RDIMM starts at 12.8 GT/s and scales to 14.4 GT/s and beyond, while module length shrinks from DDR5's 133mm to 74mm, alongside pseudo-channel organization, doubled bank counts and system-level ECC support.

原文标题：JEDEC 预览 DDR6 规范 总线宽度提升 50%

Why it matters：DDR6 规范预览明确了总线宽度、速率与模组形态的关键参数，是理解下一代服务器与 AI 算力内存底座的重要节点。
